whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Cake Bagicha,

I noticed your bakery has stellar 4.7★ reviews with 160+ happy customers in Ramkrishan Nagar, but lacked a dedicated online cake menu and direct WhatsApp ordering page.

Maine aapke bakery ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp cake booking, custom flavor showcase, aur birthday/anniversary special categories integrate ki hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/cakebagicha

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Team Cake Bagicha, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke bakery ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? [If checked]: We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp cake ordering and showcase of your 4.7-star review highlights in Ramkrishan Nagar. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? [If unchecked]: No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai. Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact cake menu aur photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Batayein, when can we connect for a quick 2-minute walkthrough?
